description: Returns the form of a dependent or a pet on the My Family page: the field keys, the labels, the options, the required fields, and the module_state. Call it before add_family_member or update_family_member. When module_state is closed, do not collect values: give the customer next_step_url. Otherwise ask the customer for each required value.
name: describe_family_form

module_state.description: The state of the module for a write of the customer. open: a write saves. edit_restarts_alignment: a write saves, restarts the alignment of the couple, and can email the partner. Tell the customer this and get a yes before the write. closed: the tools refuse a write. Do not collect values. Give the customer next_step_url.

next_step_url.description: Only for a closed module: the app page that shows the next step.

plaid_connection_url.description: Only for a bank, a credit card, an investment, or a debt when the module is not closed: the app page that connects the account through Plaid. It needs a computer: the app does not show My Assets on a phone.

title: Describe a family member form
